newsitem.title: USA: DC postpones sale of $168.87 mln in GO bonds.
newsitem.headline: DC postpones sale of $168.87 mln in GO bonds.

text.p: District of Columbia said its sale of $168.87 million general obligation bonds was postponed to Oct 3 from Sept 26.
"The District expects that the sale of the bonds will occur on or about Oct 3 and close on or about Oct 8," Anthony Williams, chief financial officer for the city, said in a press statement.
Williams said the city will announce the extended sale date and closing date over news wire services at least 24 hours before the sale date.
The sale was postponed to give Congress more time to enact a bill that would waive a current 30-day congressional review requirement for pending D.C. bond sales.
Questions should be directed to Thomas Huestis, deputy chief financial officer for D.C., at 202-727-6055.
